description: Find licensed homeowners insurance agents near a ZIP code using state department of insurance licensing data. California searches return agents within 75 miles, nearest first; Texas searches return agents in the same ZIP. ZIP codes in other states return an empty agents list alongside supported_states. Each agent record includes name, agency, license, lines, location, contact details, and source links.

limit.description: How many agent records to return. Omit it to get up to 25; Coverage Cat returns at most 50 even when asked for more.

lines.description: Insurance lines the agent should handle, such as `homeowners`, `condominium`, `dwelling_fire`, or `renters`; an agent listed for any of them matches, and synonyms such as `condo` are normalized. Omit it to search homeowners agents.

zip.description: ZIP code to search for nearby homeowners agents.

name: homeowners_agent_finder

agents.description: Matching agents and agencies, up to the requested limit.

company.description: Agency and carrier affiliations, such as represented insurers.

insurer.description: California only: insurer the agent is appointed with.

languages.description: Languages the agent lists, when the state publishes them.

last_updated_at.description: When Coverage Cat last saw this record in the state data.

lines.description: Insurance lines listed for the agent.

links.description: URLs for the source record and, when available, the license lookup.

location.description: Office address, city, state, and zip; California records add coordinates and distance_miles from the searched ZIP.

source.description: Name of the state dataset the record came from.

state.description: State whose licensing data lists the agent.

last_updated_at.description: Most recent refresh time across the returned agents; null when none were returned.

lines.description: Normalized insurance lines the search matched against.

source_label.description: Licensing data source, such as `CA Dept of Insurance`; null outside supported states.

state.description: Two-letter state code for the ZIP.

state_name.description: Full state name for the ZIP.

supported_states.description: States the finder has licensing data for.

title: Homeowners agent finder
